blockedIdentities.reason: WALTER can refer to several distinct manufacturer-owned identities, including cutting-tool, machine-tool and food-equipment companies; the raw record does not disambiguate them.

Official GERGEN material supports a current vehicle-equipment manufacturer and an older GERGEN-JUNG name, but the available source set does not establish the exact canonical relationship with sufficient certainty for automatic publication.

profiles.shortDescription: van Dinther develops hydraulic drive components and systems, including radial-piston pumps, compact high-pressure units and directional valves. Its documented range also covers configured pump, motor, valve and hydraulic-unit solutions.
fullDescription: van Dinther Antriebstechnik GmbH is a German hydraulic-technology company. Manufacturer-owned pages document in-house radial-piston pumps, compact hydraulic power units and the 4RDE directional valve alongside engineering and configuration work for hydraulic drive systems.

The official portfolio spans radial-piston, screw, internal-gear, external-gear, axial-piston and vane pump solutions, hydraulic valves, electric and hydraulic motors, high-pressure units, coolers, pressure switches and pulsation dampeners. Product pages and downloads provide technical material for component selection without exposing Ventrovia product records.

profiles.shortDescription: Berger Lahr is a Schneider Electric legacy motion-control brand associated with controllers, drives, motors and linear-motion systems. Its technology was integrated into Schneider Electric's Lexium motion portfolio.
fullDescription: Official Schneider Electric history identifies Berger Lahr as a motion-control company founded in Lahr, Germany, in 1941. It became part of Schneider Electric in 2000, and the operating company was renamed Schneider Electric Motion Deutschland in 2008.

The documented product scope includes motion controllers, servo and stepper drives and motors, integrated drives and linear-motion systems. Current Schneider Electric motion-control material places the continuing technology within the Lexium portfolio; Berger Lahr is therefore presented as a verified legacy brand, not as an independent current manufacturer.

profiles.shortDescription: BEVI develops and supplies electric-drive and power equipment. Its official range includes electric motors, transmissions, motor-control and automation equipment, generators and braking units.
fullDescription: BEVI is a Swedish industrial drive and power-technology company. Manufacturer-owned product pages organize its portfolio around electric motors, transmissions, automation and motor control, generators and brake units.

The motor range includes standard, brake, two-speed, inverter-duty, vibration, servo and application-specific motors. The wider portfolio includes gear and transmission solutions, frequency converters and controls, synchronous and asynchronous generators, and braking equipment for industrial installations.

profiles.shortDescription: CompAir is an industrial compressed-air brand offering stationary and portable compressors, dryers, air-treatment equipment and control systems. The documented range includes lubricated and oil-free technologies for plant and mobile applications.
fullDescription: CompAir develops compressed-air systems for industrial and portable use. Official brand pages document oil-lubricated screw compressors, oil-free screw technologies, water-injected systems, rotary-vane compressors and portable compressor packages.

The portfolio also includes refrigerant and desiccant dryers, filtration and air-treatment equipment, controls, pneumatic tools and supporting services. Product literature identifies multiple platform families for general industry and applications requiring oil-free compressed air.

profiles.shortDescription: Cornell Pump designs and manufactures centrifugal pumping equipment for industrial, agricultural, municipal and process duties. Its official range covers clear-liquid, solids-handling, refrigeration, hot-oil, self-priming and submersible pumps.
fullDescription: Cornell Pump Company is a US pump manufacturer founded in 1946. Official company history traces its engineering and production in Oregon, while the current product directory documents centrifugal pumps for liquids ranging from clean water and refrigerants to solids-bearing and abrasive media.

Product families include clear-liquid, cutter, hydro-transport, hot-oil, refrigeration, self-priming, solids-handling, submersible and agricultural pumps. The range serves water and wastewater, food processing, refrigeration, mining, agriculture and other industrial process applications.

profiles.shortDescription: DELLMECO manufactures air-operated and electromechanical double-diaphragm pumps. Its range includes plastic, metal, hygienic, semiconductor and application-specific pump series plus pulsation-control accessories.
fullDescription: DELLMECO identifies itself as an industrial-pump manufacturer operating since 2004. Manufacturer-owned material documents air-operated double-diaphragm pumps and electromechanically driven double-diaphragm pumps for fluids, powders and challenging process media.

The portfolio is organized into plastic, metal, hygienic, semiconductor, coatings and aseptic configurations. Named ranges include DME, DMCX, DMU, DMF, DMR and SXTT-X, supported by catalogues and accessories for chemical, food, pharmaceutical, mining, water-treatment and semiconductor applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Dürr Technik develops oil-free compressors, compressor stations and vacuum pumps for industrial, laboratory, medical and transport applications. Its range also includes air-treatment, control and vapour-recovery solutions.
fullDescription: Dürr Technik GmbH & Co. KG is a German manufacturer of compact compressed-air and vacuum technology. Its official range covers oil-free compressors, configured compressor stations, dryers and controls, laboratory systems and vacuum pumps.

Documented families include KK compressor platforms, Marathon and E-Bull systems, SICOLAB laboratory units, KV vacuum pumps and MEX vapour-recovery pumps. The products are applied in industry, medical and laboratory equipment, rail, beverage, energy and automotive systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Dynex/Rivett manufactures high-pressure hydraulic pumps, valves, motors and power units. Its portfolio includes fixed- and variable-displacement pump technologies, flow controls and application-specific hydraulic systems.
fullDescription: Dynex/Rivett Inc. is a US hydraulic-equipment manufacturer based in Pewaukee, Wisconsin. Official history records the Dynex operating lineage from the 1950s and the incorporation of Dynex/Rivett in 1977.

The current range includes fixed-displacement checkball and split-flow pumps, variable-delivery pumps, directional and pressure-control valves, hydraulic motors and power units. Product documentation covers PF and PV pump families, 8800-series valves and MF hydraulic motors for demanding industrial and mobile applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Bucher Emhart Glass develops equipment and automation for manufacturing and inspecting glass containers. Its systems cover gob forming, container forming, ware handling, process control, inspection and traceability.
fullDescription: Bucher Emhart Glass is the glass-container technology division of Bucher Industries. Official company sources identify its headquarters in Steinhausen, Switzerland, and document equipment spanning the hot end, cold end and digital control of glass-container production.

The portfolio includes feeders and gob-forming equipment, IS forming machines, ware handling, process-control systems, inspection machines and traceability solutions. Named machine platforms include NIS and AIS technologies alongside conventional IS equipment and plant-support services.

profiles.shortDescription: FELUWA develops hose-diaphragm and displacement pumps for abrasive, aggressive and hazardous process media. Its Multisafe and EcoTrans systems are used for high-pressure and demanding solids-handling duties.
fullDescription: FELUWA Pumpen GmbH is a German pump manufacturer whose official corporate history traces the business to 1901 and its Mürlenbach operations to 1960. The company has belonged to the ARCA Flow Group since 2000.

Its documented range centres on MULTISAFE double hose-diaphragm pumps, EcoTrans MULTISAFE units and related piston-diaphragm and displacement technologies. Applications include mining and tailings, chemical and petrochemical processing, filter-press feeding, gasification, hygienic transport and high-pressure reactor or autoclave feed duties.

profiles.shortDescription: HSME manufactures industrial tube-fitting and connection components. Official technical catalogues cover bite-type and instrumentation fittings, adapters, ferrules, plugs, welding and flange connections, and assembly tools.
fullDescription: HSME Corporation publishes manufacturer-owned technical catalogues for industrial tube-connection systems. The documents establish the HSME identity and describe fitting designs, materials, pressure classes, dimensions and assembly practices.

The documented range includes bite-type tube fittings, adapters, caps and plugs, ferrules, tube-to-weld and tube-to-flange connections, dielectric fittings, fusible plugs and installation tools. These products support process tubing and instrumentation connections where controlled assembly and documented specifications are required.

profiles.shortDescription: KALTENBACH manufactures machinery and systems for steel processing. Its range includes sawing, drilling, coping, plate-processing, shot-blasting, painting, material-handling and production-control solutions.
fullDescription: KALTENBACH GmbH + Co. KG is a German machinery manufacturer focused on steel fabrication and service-centre workflows. The official portfolio combines cutting and machining equipment with surface-treatment, logistics and line-control technologies.

Product groups include band and circular saws, drilling and coping systems, plate-processing machines, shot-blasting and painting lines, measuring and material-handling equipment, and software-assisted production systems. Documented series include KBS, HDM, KD, KC and KF platforms for structural steel and plate processing.

profiles.shortDescription: Mazurczak develops heating, cooling and measurement components for tanks and aggressive process liquids. Its range includes immersion heaters, heat exchangers, temperature equipment and level-monitoring devices.
fullDescription: Mazurczak GmbH is a German manufacturer of thermal and monitoring equipment for industrial liquid-treatment processes. Manufacturer-owned pages identify the Schwabach operation and document components designed for direct use in tanks, baths and process media.

The portfolio includes electric immersion and cartridge heaters, heat exchangers, temperature sensors and controllers, level sensors and monitoring equipment. Material and construction options support corrosive liquids and applications such as surface treatment, electroplating and chemical process installations.

profiles.shortDescription: Natoli Engineering manufactures tablet-compression tooling, tablet presses and supporting equipment. Its portfolio also includes replacement parts, encapsulation components, process accessories and manufacturing software.
fullDescription: Natoli Engineering Company, Inc. is a US manufacturer founded in 1973 and headquartered in St. Charles, Missouri. The company develops equipment and tooling for tablet compression and adjacent solid-dose manufacturing processes.

Official product pages document punches and dies, rotary tablet presses, machine replacement parts, encapsulation equipment and parts, data-acquisition and control software, and press-room accessories. The systems serve pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, confectionery, veterinary and industrial tablet-production applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Nihon Klingage develops industrial sight-glass, level-observation and related process components. Official company material documents glass technologies, glass-and-metal sight ports and compact magnetic floats for power and process plants.
fullDescription: Nihon Klingage Co., Ltd. is a Japanese process-equipment manufacturer operating since 1953. Its official company page connects the brand with observation and level-related technologies for power generation, chemical refining and petrochemical installations.

Documented developments include alkali-resistant and coated glass, glass-and-metal sight ports, sight-glass components and compact magnetic floats. These products support visual observation and level indication in industrial vessels and process systems.

profiles.shortDescription: PRUFTECHNIK develops maintenance and measurement systems for rotating machinery. Its portfolio covers laser alignment, vibration analysis, condition monitoring and non-destructive testing.
fullDescription: PRÜFTECHNIK was founded in 1972 and is based in Ismaning, Germany. Official company material identifies it as a maintenance-technology manufacturer and records its ownership by Fluke Corporation since 2019.

The product range includes laser shaft- and roll-alignment systems, vibration data collectors and analyzers, online condition-monitoring systems and eddy-current non-destructive testing equipment. Named platforms include OPTALIGN, ROTALIGN, PARALIGN, VIBXPERT, VIBSCANNER, VIBGUARD and EDDYCHEK.

profiles.shortDescription: RENK develops transmissions, gear units, bearings, couplings and test systems for industrial, marine, rail and vehicle applications. Its official portfolio spans mission-critical propulsion and power-transmission equipment.
fullDescription: RENK Group AG is a German engineering group headquartered in Augsburg. Manufacturer-owned material organizes its business around transmission and propulsion systems for marine and military vehicles, turbo and industrial gear units, slide bearings, couplings and test systems.

The industrial range includes helical, planetary, integral, clutch and variable-speed gearboxes, mill and extruder drives, hydropower gear units, plain bearings and multiple coupling technologies. RENK also develops railway, aviation, wind-power and vehicle test systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Robuschi manufactures low-pressure air and vacuum equipment plus centrifugal pumps. Its range includes lobe, screw, turbo and multistage blowers, liquid-ring vacuum pumps and process pumps.
fullDescription: Robuschi was founded in 1941 and has been part of Gardner Denver since 2011. Official brand pages document rotating equipment for air, gas, vacuum and liquid handling across industrial and environmental applications.

The portfolio includes positive-displacement, screw, turbo, side-channel and multistage centrifugal blowers, low-pressure screw compressors, liquid-ring vacuum pumps and centrifugal process pumps. Engineered-to-order packages and controls support wastewater, pneumatic conveying, chemical processing and other continuous-process duties.

profiles.shortDescription: Schaublin manufactures precision clamping and toolholding equipment for turning and machining. Its official range includes collets, guide bushes, collet chucks and runout-adjustment systems.
fullDescription: Schaublin SA is a Swiss precision-manufacturing company based in Delémont and part of the RBC Bearings group. Manufacturer-owned catalogues and product pages focus on workholding and clamping components for lathes, Swiss-type machines and machining systems.

The range includes collets, guide bushes, collet chucks, expanding sleeves and application-specific clamping products. The SRS runout-adjustment system is documented for holding raw material or blanks where controlled concentricity is required.

profiles.shortDescription: SEEPEX manufactures progressive-cavity pumps, pump systems, macerators and digital controls. Its range addresses low-viscosity, abrasive, shear-sensitive, viscous and solids-bearing media.
fullDescription: SEEPEX GmbH develops progressive-cavity pumping and conveying systems. Official product pages organize the portfolio into industrial, hopper, metering, hygienic, semi-submersible and special-purpose pump groups plus maceration, controls and digital services.

Named platforms include BN industrial pumps, SCT maintenance-oriented pumps, T-series hopper pumps, D-series metering pumps, CS hygienic pumps and SAI transport systems. Applications span water and wastewater, mining, food and beverage, biogas, chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical and marine processes.

profiles.shortDescription: SESINO manufactures industrial heat exchangers and cooling units for hydraulic and process applications. Its portfolio includes air-oil, water-oil, shell-and-tube and brazed-plate heat exchangers.
fullDescription: Costante Sesino S.p.A. is an Italian heat-exchanger manufacturer founded in 1919 and based in Gessate near Milan. Official company material traces its development from automotive radiators to industrial and hydraulic thermal-management equipment.

The current range includes air-oil and water-oil heat exchangers, inspectable and removable shell-and-tube units, high-pressure exchangers, brazed-plate exchangers and complete cooling units with electric fans or hydraulic motors. The products serve mobile machinery, hydraulic systems and industrial process installations.
